summary.cohort: Only pipeline-ok, roundtrip-verified, exact NPE/SAFE boundary molecules
notes: Random distinct molecule pairs sampled uniformly with replacement across trials; same sampled pairs for every representation.
Literal SAFE equality includes exact digits and SMILES traversal, not just attachment chemistry.
Normalized patterns replace internal and external ring numbers separately; lexical traversal remains, so these are not chemical isomorphism classes.

Port graphs use unnumbered dummy neighbours and canonical SMILES, preserving attachment atoms, bond types and local stereo as represented; they discard global matching identities and are NOT lossless molecule encodings.
Parent motifs use canonicalized DemoDiff-compatible graph keys. Equivalent NPE vocabulary spellings are grouped; single-atom keys inherit upstream loss of charge/isotope context.
Expected number of shared types is exact from document frequencies; it is not the probability of sharing at least one.
Census uses the same ordered first-1M corpus as NPE training, filtered to exact boundaries; not a held-out test or a random sample of all ChEMBL.
Same full cohort remains in denominator even when a molecule has no cross-fragment labels.
Labelled-only means at least one external connection. Multiatom means at least two real atoms, excluding dummy attachment atoms.
Identical labelled fragment does not assert the same neighbour outside the fragment.
Growth prefixes follow source order and can reflect ChEMBL ordering effects.
